description: This file is a shell script for testing Git ref storage format migrations. It sets up testing environments, defines functions to verify reflogs, and executes a series of test cases to ensure correct migration behavior between different ref storage formats (files, reftable).

methods.name: print_all_reflog_entries
methods.description: Prints all reflog entries for the 'main' ref in the given repository.

methods.name: test_migration
methods.description: Performs migration tests for a repository from one ref storage format to another, verifying reflog data, references, and repository state post-migration.
